name: Hallways of Time
summary:
Hallways of Time is a museum of the history of the universe, built to be walked through.

Begin at the Big Bang and follow time forward through three halls:

• The Cosmos: the first particles, the first light, the first stars and the forging of the elements.
• Life: from the first cell to the first animals and forests, through five mass extinctions and what survived them.
